requirements.requirement: The system must validate that an exact condition match produces a higher relevance score than a partial match for the same input set.
The system must validate that a partial condition match produces a non-zero relevance score when at least one condition token overlaps.
The system must validate that no condition match results in a relevance score of zero or the defined minimum baseline.
The system must validate that synonym-based matches (via embeddings or mapping) produce a relevance score greater than zero.
The system must validate that all computed relevance scores are normalized within the range defined in the scoring schema.
The system must validate that the scoring output includes contributing factors when matches are detected.
The system must validate that the scoring output includes a confidence value consistent with the schema contract.
The system must validate that multiple trial conditions are aggregated correctly into a single relevance score.
The system must validate that the clinical_trials_service response includes a relevance score field for each returned trial.
The system must validate that relevance scores persist through the Evaluate Care facade without alteration.
The system must validate that scoring logic behaves consistently across repeated identical inputs (deterministic output).
The system must validate that empty or null user condition input triggers a handled response without system failure.
The system must validate that empty or missing trial condition data results in a safe default relevance score and no runtime error.
The system must validate that integration tests cover end-to-end flow from input query to enriched clinical trial response including relevance scores.
The system must validate that test cases follow existing backend test patterns and structure under the tests directory.
